newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close mixed, key blue chips rise.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close mixed, key blue chips rise.

text.p: Key heavyweight counters continued their robust performance to bring the key index to a positive finish. But the broader market was mixed.
Merger speculation drove Malaysia Assurance higher, while Time Engineering warrants fell after spiking up on positive hopes of telecommunications industry deregulation.
Country Heights and its warrants jumped on speculation over a new property project.
The Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks gained 1.69 points to 1,216.72. The Second Board index fell 4.83 to 611.65.
The all-share EMAS index ended 0.37 points up to 1,216.72.
"There's a lot of churning in some counters. KL Industries has big volume but no story," said an institutional dealer.
Property and consumer products maker KL Industries rose to a new year-high of 5.55 ringgit before ending at 5.40, up 20 cents on the market's heaviest volume of 47.3 million.
Heavyweight stocks Maybank, EON, Rothman, United Engineers, Proton, UMW rose between 25 cents and 1.00 ringgit.
Top percentage gainer Malaysian Assurance surged 1.80 ringgit or 13.85 percent to 14.80, on speculation large insurer Malaysia National Insurance (MNI) was taking over the company.
